# Madison notice fixtures

Minimal structural excerpts of official public pages fetched October 21, 2026.
Unrelated site navigation, contact details and images are excluded.

- `madison_dayton.html`: https://www.cityofmadison.com/news/2026-10-19/closure-of-eastbound-w-dayton-street-between-n-charter-and-n-mills-streets
- `madison_broom.html`: https://www.cityofmadison.com/news/2026-10-02/temporary-street-closures-for-s-broom-and-w-doty-streets
- `madison_list.html`: first four article links from https://www.cityofmadison.com/transportation/news

Tests also generate synthetic notices with this HTML structure to exercise
cancellations, republication, time corrections, unavailable articles and malformed
content. Tests do not fetch these URLs or contact a radio.
